en.title: Wan2.2 I2V Lightning (4-8 Step Fast Video Gen Demo)
en.hook: Fast Image-to-Video generation using Wan2.2 Lightning accelerated to 4-8 inference steps
key_takeaways: Accelerates Wan2.2 architecture for ultra-fast Image-to-Video synthesis in 4-8 sampling steps
Generates realistic and coherent video clips from a single static image input
Interactive Gradio UI running on Hugging Face Spaces for quick experimentation

zh.title: Wan2.2 I2V Lightning（4-8步极速图生视频 Demo）
zh.hook: 仅需 4-8 步采样即可将静态图片快速生成高质量视频的 Wan2.2 Lightning 演示
key_takeaways: 基于 Wan2.2 架构并融合 Lightning 加速技术，实现 4-8 步极速图生视频
支持从单张输入图像快速生成自然流畅的动态视频
部署于 Hugging Face Spaces，提供简单易用的 Gradio 交互界面
